createSubtitle: An edition belongs to a series, carries its year and its period. The calendar of days is generated from the dates.

identity.hint: The series carries the lasting identity of the event; the edition carries the occurrence.

content.hint: These texts appear on the public page of the edition.

period.hint: Times are entered in the edition's time zone and converted on display. Every date shown publicly carries its zone.

location.hint: Country and city are required as soon as the edition is not entirely online.

pavilion.hint: Without a pavilion, IFDD sends a representative only and opens no call for proposals.

visuals.hint: Three crops, uploaded separately: automatic cropping beheads speakers in a conference photograph. Each shape is checked on upload; all three are optional and independent.

fields.seriesHint: Leave empty for a one-off event, outside any series.
fields.editionLabelHint: The name of the edition within its series: "COP31", "Session 7".
fields.title: Title
fields.acronymHint: Prefix of the reference codes given to organizations: "COP31-00147".
fields.slugHint: What appears in the public URL. Unique across the whole platform.
fields.highlightsHint: Access instructions, opening hours, badge requirements.
fields.timezoneHint: All times of the edition are converted from this zone.
fields.hasPavilion: OIF holds a pavilion at this edition
fields.slugAuto: Composed from the label. Editable: as soon as you touch it, it stops following.
fields.coordinatesHint: Point surveyed on site, in decimal degrees. Optional — but both together or neither.
fields.coordinatesCheck: Check the point on a map

banner.label: Panoramic banner
banner.use: tops the record and the public page

cover.label: Cover image
cover.use: home page cards and social sharing

thumbnail.label: Square thumbnail
thumbnail.use: dense lists and networks that crop to square

localeTab.missing: Translation missing: French will be shown.

errors.title: The edition could not be saved
errors.period: The end date must follow the start date.
errors.physical_location: An edition that is not entirely online requires a country and a city.
errors.slug_taken: This URL identifier is already taken by another edition.
errors.edition_taken: This series already has an edition with that year and label.
errors.year_range: The year must be between 2000 and 2100.
errors.coordinates: Latitude and longitude go together, each within its bounds: −90 to 90, −180 to 180.

saved.created: Edition created. {days} calendar days were generated.
saved.daysAdded: {count} day was added to the calendar. | {count} day was added to the calendar. | {count} days were added to the calendar.
saved.daysOutside: Some calendar days now fall outside the period. The days tab lets you remove them.

uploadNotice: Uploading will be wired to the Media module: for now, each variant is attached by asset identifier. A file that does not match the shape of its slot is rejected on upload, never cropped.
